description: Drive your real, logged-in Chrome from any MCP client — even from a remote machine, no inbound port.
name: io.github.VibeTechnologies/vibe-mcp

session_id.description: Your personal agent-connection ID from the Vibe extension (Vibe icon -> Settings -> AI Agent Control -> Remote (internet) -> Relay access). Paste the URL as-is: this endpoint is plain Streamable HTTP with no OAuth, no dynamic client registration and no scope setup. Migration: the retired consent-screen connector at a bare /mcp is unsupported -- remove it and re-add this direct URL. The ID is a bearer capability granting full control of that browser: never share it, and regenerate the session in the extension to revoke it.

title: Vibe MCP — Real Chrome, Remotely
